title: phaenopyrum carolinianum
intro: Phaenopyrum carolinianum, commonly known as Carolina buckthorn, is a plant species belonging to the Rhamnaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its various health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, fever, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of P. carolinianum are attributed to its antiseptic, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which make it useful for wound healing and relieving respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
